channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: European tech leaders join calls for AI slowdown
item.description: Pip White, who leads Anthropic's operations in the U.K., Ireland, Northern Europe, and Israel, is among the tech figures urging global cooperation on regulation.

item.title: 35% of bettors shift from sportsbooks to prediction markets
item.description: The American Gaming Association reports that states have lost $500 million in tax revenue to prediction markets.

item.title: Canada's purchases of American cars fall to new low amid tariffs
item.description: New data shows the U.S. share of new vehicles in Canada dropped from 35.4% to 28.4% in one year.

item.title: North Korea accused of stealing $387 million from Bitget in year's largest crypto attack
item.description: Hackers exploited a flaw in Bitget's wallet backend, making fraudulent withdrawals appear legitimate.
